scope: Independent EQY partitions and direct generated SAT temporal induction scripts; discrete synchronous semantics with defined formal inputs

boundaries.driver: EQY setup only; generated SAT scripts run directly; no complete EQY make driver PASS
boundaries.inputs: defined formal inputs; not arbitrary four-state X/Z simulation
boundaries.async_reset: async2sync synchronous sampling and negative-hold-time assumption; case04 has asynchronous reset
boundaries.initial_state: actual dffeas power_up low/high decoded as discrete initial state
boundaries.objects: baseline versus candidate mapped graphs, not separate RTL-to-mapped end-to-end proof
boundaries.not_covered: device timing, asynchronous event phasing, glitches, recovery/removal timing, analog power-up and power
